arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Maynard argued the Act waives immunity for federal employee torts.
She stated the Act applies private person liability principles.
She criticized the Ninth Circuit for using state entity standards.
Justice Kennedy questioned the liability of the United States for private inspectors.
